_comment: Single source of truth for the release board table.
Read by scripts/version.py (env -> BRINGUP_BOARD_ID macro), by
scripts/gen_manifest.py (which ids go into manifest.json), and by
.github/workflows/release.yml (which envs to build and what to name the
assets). In LUME this table was duplicated across all three and had to be
kept in sync by hand — here, adding a board means editing this file only.
env   PlatformIO environment name, must match an [env:...] in platformio.ini
id    release asset id; appears in manifest.json and in the .bin filenames
as <project>-<id>.bin / littlefs-<id>.bin, and is baked into the
firmware as BRINGUP_BOARD_ID so a running device knows which
manifest entry is its own. Changing an id orphans deployed devices
from their update path, so treat ids as permanent once shipped.
label human-readable, used in generated release notes only
